title: EquipmentTree
description: Hierarchy of equipment (site, area, unit, module) with a status per node, that the operator expands, collapses and selects (IND-119).

value.description: Id of the selected node, empty for none. Set by the host, or by the operator selecting a node in control mode.

id.description: Unique id; missing or empty: the path of labels from the root joined by '/'.

level.description: Level shown next to the label (site, area, unit, ...).

status.description: Status of the node, from the least to the most severe; a collapsed node also shows the most severe status below it.

children.description: Child nodes, of the same form.

nodes.description: Root nodes, each {label, id, level, status, children}. Python rejects a node without a label, an unknown status or a repeated id; without a kernel such a node (and its children) is skipped.

expanded.description: Ids of the expanded nodes. Set by the host, or by the operator expanding and collapsing nodes.

show_level.description: Show the level of each node next to its label.
